app.title: Canada Post Claim Runner
app.subtitle: Import shipping history, automatically identify late candidates, then submit them in two simple steps.
setup.title: Welcome — readiness setup
setup.intro: Canada Post Claim Runner keeps credentials, operational records, and browser sessions on this device. Setup never tests an account or submits a claim automatically.
setup.safety: Step 2 submits only selected, authoritative late-delivery candidates after silent preflight. CAPTCHA and text verification stay manual in the visible built-in browser.
setup.safetyAcknowledge: I understand that setup does not authorize Step 1 or Step 2 and that selected Step 2 candidates are submitted live.
setup.step.local.title: Local-only data
setup.step.local.detail: Private application storage and database health. Runtime data stays outside the installation.

setup.step.submission.title: Submission readiness
setup.step.submission.detail: Step 2 uses the built-in browser and silently validates the selected authoritative candidates before submission.
setup.step.external.title: External checks
setup.step.external.detail: Network, account access, CAPTCHA, text verification, legal approval, and real claims require supervised human action.

step2.candidateExplanation: This step compares the successful-delivery date against the original Delivery Standard. A shipment becomes a late-delivery candidate when successful delivery occurred after that standard. First-attempt, service, policy, and claim-window information remains advisory. Canada Post makes the final eligibility decision.

setupAssistant.step.createApp.guidance: Open Apps. Use an existing suitable Production app when one is clearly available, or choose Create new app. For a new app, select Production, enter Claim Runner as the App name and choose Create yourself.
setupAssistant.step.createApp.expected: APPS, CREATE NEW APP, SELECT PRODUCTION, then CREATE APP
setupAssistant.step.createApp.fallback: Do not create a duplicate app if an existing Production app is suitable. Claim Runner never clicks Create automatically.
setupAssistant.step.credentials.label: Save API credentials
setupAssistant.step.credentials.title: Save your API credentials
setupAssistant.step.credentials.guidance: On App credentials generated, choose Copy API Key and paste it below, then choose Copy API Secret and paste it below. Do not use Show password. OK is highlighted only after both local fields are populated.
setupAssistant.step.credentials.expected: COPY API KEY, COPY API SECRET, then CONTINUE
setupAssistant.step.credentials.fallback: Canada Post shows these credentials when the app is created. Claim Runner never reads either credential from the page and does not store them before Save & Finish.
setupAssistant.step.tracking.label: Enable Tracking API
setupAssistant.step.tracking.title: Enable the Tracking API
setupAssistant.step.tracking.guidance: After OK, use the new Production application's API products section. Choose Add API product, then select a clearly identified Tracking API product.
setupAssistant.step.tracking.expected: ADD API PRODUCT, then SELECT TRACKING API
setupAssistant.step.tracking.fallback: Find the Tracking API product in Canada Post's list and select it. If the page layout has changed, you can continue manually; setup is not blocked when no reliable target exists.
setupAssistant.step.finish.label: Finish
setupAssistant.step.finish.title: SETUP COMPLETE
setupAssistant.step.finish.guidance: Confirm that every required item is ready, then choose Save & Finish. Missing items remain marked until you enter them or they are already securely stored.
setupAssistant.step.finish.expected: Every checklist item marked ready or securely saved
setupAssistant.step.finish.fallback: Nothing is saved until you choose Save & Finish.
setupAssistant.state.portalSignIn.title: Sign in to Canada Post
setupAssistant.state.portalSignIn.guidan: Open the User menu and choose Sign in. This is a normal Canada Post page navigation.
setupAssistant.state.portalSignIn.expect: The pulsing SIGN IN HERE link inside User menu
setupAssistant.state.portalSignIn.fallba: Look for the accessible User menu, then its Sign in link.
setupAssistant.state.login.title: Enter your Canada Post sign-in
setupAssistant.state.login.guidance: Enter your Canada Post Web Username and normal password in the website, then choose Sign in. Also enter the same username and password in Claim Runner's local fields for future claim processing.
setupAssistant.state.login.expected: Username, Password and the pulsing SIGN IN HERE button
setupAssistant.state.login.fallback: Use Canada's Post account-recovery or Forgot Password flow if needed. Claim Runner never reads the website password field.
setupAssistant.state.identity.title: VERIFY YOUR IDENTITY
setupAssistant.state.identity.guidance: Complete the Canada Post verification shown in the browser, then click Continue.
setupAssistant.state.identity.expected: The verification choice and Continue control shown by Canada Post
setupAssistant.state.identity.fallback: Claim Runner never reads or saves verification answers or codes.
setupAssistant.state.postAuthSettling.ti: CANADA POST IS FINISHING YOUR SIGN-IN
setupAssistant.state.postAuthSettling.gu: Canada Post is loading your Developer Portal account. Please wait — you do not need to click anything yet.
setupAssistant.state.postAuthSettling.ex: The final authenticated Developer Portal page
setupAssistant.state.postAuthSettling.fa: Claim Runner will continue when the page remains stable. Session-limit or verification pages interrupt this wait immediately.
setupAssistant.state.identityMethod.titl: CHOOSE HOW TO VERIFY YOUR IDENTITY
setupAssistant.state.identityMethod.guid: Canada Post is asking how you want to verify your account. Choose one of the available verification methods, then click Continue.
setupAssistant.state.identityMethod.expe: A verification-method choice, then the highlighted Continue button
setupAssistant.state.identityMethod.fall: Claim Runner does not choose a method or read any challenge response.
setupAssistant.state.securityQuestion.gu: Enter the answer requested by Canada Post, then click Continue.
setupAssistant.state.securityQuestion.ex: The security-answer field and Continue button
setupAssistant.state.securityQuestion.fa: Claim Runner never reads or stores the security answer.
setupAssistant.state.mfaIntro.title: Verify your Canada Post account
setupAssistant.state.mfaIntro.guidance: Canada Post needs to confirm your identity. Choose Continue to proceed to access-code entry.
setupAssistant.state.mfaIntro.fallback: Complete the verification manually. Claim Runner does not bypass identity checks.
setupAssistant.state.mfaCode.title: Enter your access code
setupAssistant.state.mfaCode.guidance: Enter the access code Canada Post sent you, then choose Continue.
setupAssistant.state.mfaCode.expected: The pulsing ENTER YOUR ACCESS CODE field, then Continue
setupAssistant.state.mfaCode.fallback: Claim Runner never reads, saves or autofills the access code.
setupAssistant.state.sessionLimit.title: Canada Post session limit
setupAssistant.state.sessionLimit.guidan: Canada Post says too many account sessions are active. Select an older session you no longer need and choose Disconnect session.
setupAssistant.state.sessionLimit.expect: A session choice and the pulsing DISCONNECT AN OLD SESSION button
setupAssistant.state.sessionLimit.fallba: You must choose and confirm the session yourself. Claim Runner never disconnects one automatically.
setupAssistant.state.business.title: Choose your business
setupAssistant.state.business.guidance: Select the Canada Post business account that sends the shipments Claim Runner will monitor. Confirm the detected business and customer number before replacing any saved setting.
setupAssistant.state.business.expected: The pulsing SELECT YOUR BUSINESS control
setupAssistant.state.business.fallback: If multiple businesses are shown, choose one explicitly. Claim Runner does not guess.
setupAssistant.state.businessTargetResol: Claim Runner is locating the current-business control in the authenticated Canada Post header. Please wait — the yellow indicator will appear when it is ready.
The current-business control immediately before your profile menu
Do not click another organization or the profile menu while Claim Runner finishes locating the control.
setupAssistant.state.businessMenu.title: OPEN YOUR BUSINESS MENU
setupAssistant.state.businessMenu.guidan: Look at the top-right of the Canada Post page. Click the highlighted business name: {businessName}. This opens your Canada Post business menu so Claim Runner can find your customer number. Claim Runner will continue automatically after you open it.
setupAssistant.state.businessMenu.expect: The highlighted CLICK YOUR BUSINESS NAME control
setupAssistant.state.businessMenu.fallba: If the number is not visible: 1. Click your business name at the top-right. 2. Click View organization settings. 3. Claim Runner will detect the Customer number on that page.
setupAssistant.state.businessMenuIndicat: We found your business menu, but couldn't draw the indicator. Click "{businessName}" at the top-right of Canada Post. Your customer number is inside this menu.
CLICK YOUR BUSINESS NAME at the top-right of Canada Post
Click the business name shown above. Claim Runner will continue automatically after the menu opens.
setupAssistant.state.businessSettings.gu: The business menu is open. Click View organization settings. Claim Runner will detect the Customer number shown on that page.
setupAssistant.state.businessSettings.ex: The highlighted View organization settings link
setupAssistant.state.businessSettings.fa: In the open business menu, choose View organization settings. Manual Customer Number entry is only a last fallback.
setupAssistant.state.businessFound.title: CONFIRM YOUR BUSINESS ACCOUNT
setupAssistant.state.businessFound.guida: Claim Runner found the business name and customer number shown by Canada Post. Confirm the account below, or choose another.
setupAssistant.state.businessFound.expec: Yes, use this account; or No, choose another
setupAssistant.state.businessFound.fallb: The detected number remains temporary until Save & Finish.
setupAssistant.state.apps.title: OPEN APPS
setupAssistant.state.apps.guidance: Your business account is confirmed. Click Apps in the menu across the top of the Canada Post page.
setupAssistant.state.apps.fallback: Use the accessible link named Apps.
setupAssistant.state.appsList.title: Choose or create a Production app
setupAssistant.state.appsList.guidance: Use an existing suitable Production app, or choose Create new app when Claim Runner needs a new one.
setupAssistant.state.appsList.expected: USE EXISTING APP or CREATE NEW APP
setupAssistant.state.appsList.fallback: Avoid duplicate applications. Existing-app use remains a deliberate choice.
setupAssistant.state.createApp.title: Create the Claim Runner Production app
setupAssistant.state.createApp.guidance: Select Production, enter Claim Runner in App name, then choose Create. Canada Post will create a Production API application for Claim Runner.
setupAssistant.state.createApp.expected: SELECT PRODUCTION, App name, then CREATE APP
setupAssistant.state.createApp.fallback: Claim Runner does not click Create automatically because application creation must be deliberate.
setupAssistant.state.createAppProduction: Claim Runner needs a Production app. Select Production to continue.
Do not use Test for Claim Runner's live Tracking setup.
setupAssistant.state.createAppTest.title: ✕ TEST APP SELECTED
setupAssistant.state.createAppTest.guida: Claim Runner needs a Production app. Select Production to continue.
setupAssistant.state.createAppTest.fallb: Claim Runner never changes the application type automatically.
setupAssistant.state.createAppName.title: NAME YOUR APP
setupAssistant.state.createAppName.guida: Enter a name for this Canada Post application. Recommended: Claim Runner. You can use another name if you prefer.
setupAssistant.state.createAppName.fallb: Description is optional and does not block setup.
setupAssistant.state.createAppReady.fall: Canada Post creates the application only when you click Create.
setupAssistant.state.credentials.title: Save your API credentials
setupAssistant.state.credentials.guidanc: Copy the API Key and API Secret into the local Claim Runner fields. The highlight advances to OK only after both local fields are populated.
setupAssistant.state.credentials.expecte: COPY API KEY, COPY API SECRET, then CONTINUE
setupAssistant.state.credentials.fallbac: Do not click Show password. The recorded Copy controls work without revealing either credential.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsKey.guid: Click Copy API Key on Canada Post, then paste it in the field below.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsKey.expe: Copy API Key, then the local API Key field
setupAssistant.state.credentialsKey.fall: Claim Runner never reads the API Key from the page.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsSecret.g: Click Copy API Secret on Canada Post, then paste it in the secure field below.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsSecret.e: Copy API Secret, then the local API Secret field
setupAssistant.state.credentialsSecret.f: Do not reveal the secret. Claim Runner never reads it from the page.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsDone.gui: Your API Key and API Secret are ready to save. Click OK on Canada Post to continue.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsDone.fal: Both credentials remain temporary until Save & Finish.
On the Canada Post page, click the highlighted Copy API Key button.
Claim Runner does not read the remote value or your clipboard.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsPasteKey: Paste the API Key you just copied from Canada Post into the highlighted field below.
Return to Copy API Key if the clipboard no longer contains it.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsCopySecr: On the Canada Post page, click the highlighted Copy API Secret button.
Do not reveal the secret. Claim Runner never reads it remotely.
setupAssistant.state.credentialsPasteSec: Paste the API Secret you just copied from Canada Post into the highlighted masked field below.
The local masked API Secret field
Claim Runner never reads clipboard contents programmatically.
setupAssistant.state.apiProducts.title: Enable the Tracking API
setupAssistant.state.apiProducts.guidanc: Your Production app is created. In API products, choose Add API product so Claim Runner can check shipment delivery status.
setupAssistant.state.apiProducts.expecte: The pulsing ADD API PRODUCT control
setupAssistant.state.apiProducts.fallbac: Creating the app does not automatically add products. Credentials come first; API-product assignment comes next.
setupAssistant.state.trackingProduct.gui: Tracking (2.0.0) is the API you need. Select the highlighted product, then click Add to enable it for this Production app.
setupAssistant.state.trackingProduct.exp: Tracking (2.0.0) marked REQUIRED, then the highlighted CLICK ADD button
setupAssistant.state.trackingProduct.fal: Find the Tracking API product in Canada Post's list and select it. If the layout changed, continue manually.
setupAssistant.state.productCatalog.guid: Claim Runner requires the Canada Post Tracking 2.0 API. Do not select Rating, Shipping, Returns, or another API product. Find Tracking 2.0.0 and click its highlighted Get access button.
setupAssistant.state.productCatalog.expe: Tracking 2.0.0 marked REQUIRED and its highlighted Get access to Tracking control
setupAssistant.state.productCatalog.fall: Find Tracking 2.0.0 in the open dialog and choose its Get access control. Do not choose Rating, Shipping, Returns, or another product.
setupAssistant.state.productCatalogMissi: Find Tracking 2.0.0 in the open Add API product catalog. Claim Runner will highlight Get access as soon as that exact Tracking control is available.
Get access on the Tracking product—not Rating, Shipping, or Customer Information Services
Scroll the open product catalog to Tracking and choose its Get access control.
setupAssistant.state.trackingConfirmatio: ✓ CORRECT API PRODUCT — Tracking 2.0.0 selected. Canada Post is ready to add it with Default plan. Click Add to enable Tracking for this Production app.
The exact CLICK ADD link inside the active dialog
Use Add in the confirmation dialog. Back and the background Add API product button are not the target.
setupAssistant.state.wrongApiProduct.gui: You selected {selectedProduct}. Claim Runner requires Tracking 2.0.0. Click Back and choose Tracking 2.0.0 instead.
setupAssistant.state.wrongApiProduct.fal: Do not click Add for this product. Claim Runner does not remove or change products automatically.
setupAssistant.state.trackingStillRequir: Another product was added, but Claim Runner still needs Tracking 2.0.0. Click Add API product and add Tracking 2.0.0.
Other products can remain installed; Tracking must also be present.
setupAssistant.state.offFlow.title: ✕ YOU’VE LEFT GUIDED SETUP
setupAssistant.state.offFlow.guidance: This Canada Post page isn’t part of the setup process. Nothing was changed by Claim Runner. Use Back to return to the previous setup page.
setupAssistant.state.offFlow.fallback: Back uses the browser’s real approved Canada Post navigation history. It is disabled when no safe history entry exists.
setupAssistant.settling.wait: Please wait — you do not need to click anything yet.
setupAssistant.businessConfirmed.title: ✓ BUSINESS CONFIRMED
setupAssistant.state.complete.title: Tracking API enabled
setupAssistant.state.complete.guidance: The application dashboard indicates Tracking access is enabled. Review the local checklist and choose Save & Finish.
setupAssistant.state.complete.expected: Every required local item ready or saved securely
setupAssistant.state.complete.fallback: If Canada Post still shows no Tracking access, return to API products and complete the product selection manually.
setupAssistant.state.trackingEnabled.gui: TRACKING API ENABLED ✓ Canada Post confirms that Tracking (2.0.0) is enabled. Review the setup checklist and save your settings.
setupAssistant.state.trackingEnabled.fal: Tracking is already assigned; do not add it again.
setupAssistant.check.clientId: Tracking API Client ID / API Key
setupAssistant.page.loading: Opening an approved Canada Post page…
setupAssistant.page.preparing: Preparing the secure Canada Post browser…
setupAssistant.page.targetFound: The suggested page control is highlighted. You can also navigate manually within the approved Canada Post sites.
setupAssistant.page.manualFallback: No reliable page target was found. The Canada Post layout may have changed; follow the written guidance and continue manually.
setupAssistant.page.knownStateNoTarget: Claim Runner recognizes this step. Follow the specific instruction in the guidance panel.
setupAssistant.error.protectedOperation: Guided Setup cannot open while Step 2 or another protected operation is active. Finish or stop that operation first.
setupAssistant.error.step3Active: Close the active Step 2 browser before using Guided Setup.
setupAssistant.error.step3Blocked: Close Guided Canada Post Setup before starting Step 2.
setupAssistant.error.open: Guided Setup could not open. Finish any active operation and try again.
setupAssistant.error.navigation: The next Canada Post setup page could not be opened. You can retry or close Setup safely.
setupAssistant.error.navigationBlocked: Sign-in redirect blocked: {hostname}. Only the hostname was retained. Retry this step or continue using the approved Canada Post page.
setupAssistant.error.loadFailed: Canada Post sign-in could not load. Host: {hostname}. Error: {category}. You can retry this step or close Setup safely.
setupAssistant.error.browserStopped: The secure Canada Post browser stopped. Host: {hostname}. Error: {category}. Close Setup and open it again to start a fresh browser.
setupAssistant.error.browserStart: Canada Post browser could not start. Choose Retry browser to create a new secure browser, or Close Setup.
setupAssistant.error.customerNumberUse: That customer-number candidate is no longer available. Reopen or retry this step.
setupAssistant.error.incomplete: Complete every required local field before saving.
setupAssistant.error.credentialSave: One or more credentials could not be saved securely. Nothing is complete yet; keep Setup open and review the Settings error or warning before retrying.
setupAssistant.error.save: Settings were not saved. Review the Settings error and try again.
setupAssistant.error.backUnavailable: A safe previous Canada Post setup page is not available.
setupAssistant.error.startOver: Guided Setup could not start over. Your entered information is still available.
step1.simpleDescription: Import shipping history, then automatically identify late-delivery candidates.
